name: - Orion Protocol
fix_description: In depositAsset, add reentrancy guard. The function performs external token transfers that can trigger callbacks before deposit accounting is finalized.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a protocol-specific reentrancy exploit that requires setting up malicious liquidity pairs, using a flash swap, triggering a callback via a custom token transfer, and understanding Orion’s internal balance accounting during swap/deposit/withdraw flows. While not extremely long, it involves multiple contracts and nontrivial DeFi interaction beyond a simple single-function bug.
